noncomputable def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (p : α → Prop) (hdec : DecidablePred p) (x₀ : {a // p a} → β) :
    {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} ≃ ({a // ¬p a} → β) :=
  let f : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} → {a // ¬p a} → β := λ x y, x.val y
  let g : {a // ¬p a} → β → {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} := λ y x, ⟨x, λ a, by
    cases hdec a; simp [p, x₀, f]; tauto
  ⟩
  let hf : ∀ x, f x ∘ g x = id :=
    λ x, by
      ext y
      dsimp
      rw [g]
      simp
  let hg : ∀ y, g y ∘ f y = id :=
    λ y, by
      ext x
      dsimp
      rw [f]
      simp
  Equiv.ofBijective (λ x, ⟨x, g (Subtype.val x), hf x⟩) (λ y, ⟨y, f (Subtype.val y), hg y⟩)
    (by
      intros ⟨x, hx⟩
      use [x, hx, hg x])
    (by
      intros ⟨y, hy⟩
      use [y, hy, hf y]))
